name: Lori G. Cohen
tagline: Top rated Products Liability attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
about: Lori G. Cohen is an attorney providing legal services covering Personal Injury - Products: Defense, Class Action / Mass Torts: Defense and Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Defense.

Lori Cohen, who practices law in Atlanta, Georgia, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Emory University School of Law. She graduated in 1990. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1990.
